Definition: fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence
BiblicalUsage: yirʼâh is the Bible's word for fear, reverence. In Genesis 20:11, Surely the fear of God is not in this place. Wherever it appears, the word means this and not something vaguer.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the fear of the LORD is not terror that drives me away; it is reverence that keeps me close, and it is the beginning of wisdom. That is why I hold yirʼâh fast when easier words tempt me away.
